title: v1 contact read endpoints stopped returning list memberships on 2026-04-30
summary: With the Contact Lists v1 sunset, six v1 contact read endpoints (get by vid, email or utk, and their batch versions) keep working but, since 2026-04-30, no longer return list memberships. The field in the v1 response is list-memberships (requested with showListMemberships); code that reads it now gets no membership data, without an error.
migrationNote: Stop reading list-memberships from /contacts/v1/contact/... responses. Map stored legacy list ids to new list ids with /crm/lists/2026-03/idmapping, then read list members from GET /crm/lists/2026-03/{listId}/memberships (results ordered by record id) and build the contact-to-list mapping from that, or move contact reads to the current CRM objects API together with the Lists API.
